algorithm: Diffusion Transformer (DDIM), 8 blocks, adaLN conditioning; CLIP ViT-B/16 image encoder + frozen CLIP text encoder
success_criterion: binary success rate (SR) plus rubric-based Task Completion (TC): milestone credits summed and divided by milestone count
headline_metric: success rate (SR) and task completion (TC), with Beta-posterior violin plots and Bonferroni-corrected Compact Letter Display pairwise comparisons
headline_value: finetuned LBM statistically same-or-better than the single-task baseline on 3/3 seen real tasks and 15/16 seen sim tasks; needs less than 30% of the data to match single-task performance in sim (Sec. III-A)
human_data: TRI-Ramen (545h, 532 tasks, 64,262 demos) + OXE-Ramen (~1150h subset of Open-X)
paper_code_mismatch: A data-normalization bug was discovered after the real-world evaluations were run (some datagrams normalized with another source's parameters); the real-world experiments were not re-run to correct for it, only a simulation re-check was performed.
